title: Fruit Madness
description: Fruit madness — a vanilla-style mod that adds fruits with some pretty crazy uses.
body:
### **FruitMadness**

Welcome to Fruit Madness — a wild fruit-themed addition that brings juicy mangoes, deadly weapons, and a touch of magic to your Minecraft world! This is the first version of the mod, featuring the king of tropical fruits — the Mango.

The mod adds a new tree — the mango tree — along with various building blocks made from its wood, as well as unique mechanics involving golden fruits and a blowgun.

### **FEATURES**
🌳 **Mango**
New mango trees generate in the world. You can find them growing in... deserts! (Yes, that's where they thrive in this crazy mod). Cutting down the tree yields:

- **Mango Logs** — the base material for all further crafting.
- **Mango Leaves** — beautiful, slightly lighter-colored foliage. They have a small chance to drop saplings or fruit.

### 🍊 **Fruits**

The main treasure of the mod is the mango fruit, which can be eaten or used as a crafting ingredient.

- **Mango**:
- A tasty and nutritious fruit. Restores 4 hunger points.
- Can drop from mango leaves.

- **Golden Mango**:
- A true fruit of the gods! Crafted from a regular mango surrounded by gold nuggets.
- When eaten, it grants powerful effects:
- Fire Resistance II for a full minute.
- Blessing for 30 seconds.

But the most interesting part happens after you eat it: 1-2 Golden Pits pop out of you, ready to be used!

### 🔫 **Weapons**

The craziest way to attack your enemies.

- **Golden Pit**:
- Can be thrown like a regular projectile.
- On impact, it sets the target on fire and creates a small fire zone around the impact area.
- Drops from you after eating a Golden Mango or can be found in chests.

- **Blowgun**:
- Designed specifically to shoot Golden Pits.
- Features charge progression: the longer you hold right-click, the farther and more powerful the shot.
- A pit fired from the blowgun deals increased damage and creates a fire zone 3 times larger than a simple throw!

### ✨ **Blessing**

A new unique status effect. When active (for example, after eating a Golden Mango), the player shoots 8 Golden Pits in all directions every 2 seconds! The effect level increases their speed. Create your own fireworks show!

### 🧱 **Building**

Mango logs can be crafted into all the standard wooden building blocks:
- Planks, slabs, stairs.
- Fences, fence gates.
- Buttons, pressure plates.

All wooden blocks are flammable and can be used as fuel in a furnace.

### 🗺️ **Generation**

- Mango trees generate in the Desert biome.
- Mangoes, Golden Mangoes, Golden Pits, and Blowguns can be found in chests located in:
- Jungle Temples.
- Desert Pyramids.
  
### 💰 **Trading**

The Wandering Trader may now offer you mangoes, mango logs, and mango leaves in exchange for emeralds.

### 🦈 **Experimental Feature: Sharks**

**Note**: This content is currently in an experimental stage!

As part of a cross-mod development experiment, Sharks have been temporarily added to Fruit Madness. They are not directly related to the fruit theme but serve as a preview of features planned for another mod: **Around the World** — a project focused on world exploration and new creatures, currently in very early development.

- Sharks spawn in ocean biomes, making the seas more lively and interesting.
- They are hostile and will attack players.
- Baby sharks can be caught and carried in buckets! Keep them as pets or transport them to your own private aquarium.
- Defeating a shark may drop useful materials for future updates.

These creatures are placeholders and will be moved to the Around the World mod once it reaches a more stable release. For now, enjoy this sneak peek into a wilder, more dangerous ocean!

### **Future**

This is just the beginning! Future versions will bring new crazy fruits and mechanics. Stay tuned!
